names: Marriott SoMa Mission Bay Hotel (2018 working name)
summary: A 299-room hotel at 100 Channel Street designed by Hornberger + Worstell, which Potrero View reports opened in June 2022 as Mission Bay's first hotel after a March 2018 groundbreaking by developer Lawrence Lui (SOMA Hotel, a Stanford Hotel affiliate per Hoodline).

milestones.text: Department of Building Inspection new-construction permit application 201509227707 filed to erect a 17-story, 250-room hotel with no basement at 100 Channel St (estimated cost $60,000,000)
Groundbreaking ceremony with Mayor Mark Farrell for the hotel, then called Marriott SoMa Mission Bay, scheduled to open in 2020
LUMA Hotel opens at 100 Channel Street, Mission Bay's first hotel
Potrero View reports the 17th-floor Sky Lounge rooftop bar planned to debut in the fall

costs.what: Estimated cost stated on new-construction permit 201509227707 (self-reported for the permit fee)

facts.value: 100 Channel St, at the corner of Channel and Third Streets
Lawrence Lui (SOMA Hotels president) per the San Francisco Chronicle; 'Stanford Hotel affiliate developer SOMA Hotel' per Hoodline
299 guestrooms and suites at opening (Potrero View, 2022); 250 rooms in 2018 coverage and on the permit
17 per the San Francisco Chronicle (2018) and the permit; Hoodline said 16

sources.title: LUMA Becomes Mission Bay's First Hotel
Groundbreaking for SF hotel marks milestone for Mission Bay
'Marriott SOMA Mission Bay' Hotel Breaks Ground
Building permit 201509227707, new construction, 100 Channel St
sources.publisher: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection

open_questions: Hospitality Net's opening announcement (cited in the map note) could not be opened (HTTP 403); the opening month comes from Potrero View alone (article dated September 2022: 'In June, LUMA Hotel opened').
Cole Martinez Curtis & Associates as interior designer (map note) is not stated by any source read.
Construction cost, and why the opening moved from the 2020 target to 2022, are not stated in any source read.

The Department of Building Inspection shows the new-construction permit completed on 2024-05-07, long after the June 2022 opening; this is a permit closeout date and is not used as the completion date.
